claims.title: Complete fixed-target cofactor-capacity trichotomy
claims.statement: For h=4j-1>t, every positive divisor W of j^2 congruent to t modulo h is uniquely either the canonical word W=t, the companion W=4tj, or a finite word with exact inverse label (ell,w,n,V). The three branches are disjoint and the input-grade condition h>t remains part of the finite converse.

claims.title: Sharp finite-repair boundary and eventual exact capacity
claims.statement: Every finite cofactor word satisfies h<=t^2-3t+1, with equality exactly for w=n=1 and t=4ell+2. Above max(t,t^2-3t+1), capacity is exactly the sum of the canonical and companion indicators. Every finite word also yields the exact smaller returned grade h_M<=ell<t/4.

claims.title: Forced nonsquare negative-shape channel returns
claims.proof: core.tex, Theorem 4.1, equations (16) and the complete same-grade return in equations (5)-(6)
claims.statement: At every prime p congruent to 1 modulo 24, an existing original exterior state forces the canonical same-prime middle return on alpha=-4t for t in {1,2,3} and on beta=-4t for every t dividing 36. The coefficients need not be squares, and no bound is placed on the other shape coordinate.

claims.title: Prime-realized sharp capacity boundary
claims.statement: For every t=6+420z, an explicitly reduced linear progression contains infinitely many hard primes with an original exterior state whose canonical word is absent and whose finite word attains h=t^2-3t+1. The p=825241 state gives an exact nonsquare t=6 witness and same-prime middle return.

claims.title: Infinite limitation of universal same-grade alpha repair
claims.statement: For every fixed t>=4, infinitely many hard primes have a constructed original exterior state with alpha=-4t but an empty complete middle cofactor box at that state's original grade h. Each prime already has the displayed exterior solution; the theorem is a same-grade obstruction and is not an Erdos-Straus counterexample.

nonclaims: No universal Erdos-Straus or Type-II occupancy theorem is inferred.
The finite-repair bound does not apply to the unbounded companion branch.
Empty same-grade middle capacity does not imply an empty Erdos-Straus source.
The bounded Python replays are not Lean proofs or external peer review.
